question: Can repeated photographed detail establish the proposed Fr 8994 capture 1/2 or 3/4 overlap?
prior_exposure: E33/E34 and the interrupted preceding turn inspected all four originals. This is an exploratory follow-up, not a blind or preregistered discovery test. This file is saved before running the numerical test.
hypothesis: Captures 1/2 and 3/4 are complementary views of two surfaces, possibly sharing a narrow photographed strip.
alternatives: Adjacent regions without any photographed overlap
Different surfaces, possibly with consecutive text
Deformation, folds, ink loss or insufficient resolution prevents registration
Shared notation or letterforms produces misleading point matches
selection: Two E34 proposed boundaries; one previously observed Fr 20274 overlap; one same-photograph resolution control; two non-repeated-detail controls. No new candidate selection or matching-model evaluation.

pairs.role: same-photograph resolution control; not an independent capture
non-repeated-detail control; different displayed text, not a codex negative
different-object, non-repeated-detail control; not an independently adjudicated book negative

method.implementation: OpenCV 4.13.0 isolated dependency already recorded by E20; no new installation
method.preprocessing: Crop only in memory; RGB to gray; CLAHE clipLimit=2, tileGridSize=8x8. ROIs exclude external rulers.
method.fit: Homography RANSAC threshold 3px, maxIters=2000, confidence=0.995; RNG seed=35 for each pair
method.screen: At least 8 mutual matches and 8 inliers, at least 8 distinct inlier positions on each image after 2px deduplication, and inlier span >=0.20 of both ROI axes on each image
method.decision: Passing the screen triggers visual review of distributed distinctive ink/damage. The fit alone establishes neither a seam, a medieval side nor a codex relation.
method.failure: A failed screen is absence of accepted registration under this fixed procedure, not evidence of different surfaces.
method.no_retry: Do not adjust ROIs, thresholds or transforms in response to results. Record all six results and controls.

constraints: No downloads, source-image changes, predictor changes, reranking or frozen review mutations. Diagnostic figures are local analysis derivatives, not additional source captures.
previous_turn_classification: No progress: the interrupted preceding turn re-read existing state/images and produced no new result or authoritative-state change. No live process or global blocker is inferred.
